messages:
joey: Sundae sprint idea — walk to the office kitchen at 4:30, build-your-own sundaes + 10-min emoji trivia. Quick, fun? 🍨🕒
tara: love it. Count me in. Can we do dairy-free options? 🥛🚫
mike: I'll bring sprinkles and cups. Also can run a 5-question emoji quiz (prizes: bragging rights + leftover ice cream) :trophy:
anya: I'm in. Need to leave by 5:15 tho. 4:30 works.
sam: @joey can you reserve the lounge table? it's usually free after 4.
ops-bot: Meeting room 'Commons' booked 4:20–5:10 by joey.
joey: booked it—thanks ops-bot. Budget? suggest $40 for toppings + 2 non-dairy pints. anyone chip in $5? 
tara: $5 from me.
mike: i got this one; will bring a tiny bluetooth speaker for background music. playlist requests? 🎶
anya: chill indie or lo-fi pls.
devrel-bot: Quick poll: emoji quiz categories? Reply with the emoji for your pick: 🧠 general trivia, 🎬 movies, 🧩 puzzles
sam: 🧠
joey: 🎬
tara: 🧠
mike: 🧩
joey: Great — looks like 'general trivia' wins. I'll prep 10 quick emoji questions. See you 4:30 in Commons! :wave:
